findings.title: _ReferralCard is render-gated on a non-empty code, so a code-less trainer cannot reach the Generate affordance
findings.problem: The Change/Generate and custom-code affordance lives inside _ReferralCard, which the Profile screen renders only when profile.referralCode is non-empty. The design's own §5.7 edge case (trainer registration fails after Firebase user creation) produces a code-less trainer, who would then have no in-Profile path to create a first code, conflicting with the 'create it later from Profile' requirement.
findings.fix: Render the trainer referral section unconditionally for trainer accounts. When referralCode is null/empty, show a 'Create referral code' state (Generate / Choose custom) instead of hiding the card.

findings.title: GET /api/student/trainer response shape to MyTrainer.none mapping is assumed but not stated
findings.problem: studentService.getTrainer returns { trainer: null } for the no-active-link case, but §5.3/§5.5 reference a MyTrainer.none state without stating the parse mapping or confirming the endpoint is unchanged.
findings.fix: In §5.5 state explicitly: { trainer: null } maps to MyTrainer.none and { trainer: {...} } to MyTrainer.connected; confirm GET /api/student/trainer needs no backend change.

findings.title: registerTrainerSchema takes email/photoUrl from the token 'where possible' without pinning absent-field behavior
findings.problem: register-trainer reads email/photoUrl from the verified token 'where possible', but email can be absent on some providers and there is no photo on an email/password token. The design does not state what the trainer doc stores when these are missing.
findings.fix: Pin the rule: email is read from the decoded token (req.user.email) and stored as null if absent; photoUrl defaults to null at registration (deferred per §8); the client never asserts either.
